unreachable.reason: Provably unreachable: every RV32I instruction word has bits [1:0] == 2'b11 (the opcode field [6:0] is always odd with bit 1 set), so the fetched IMEM word's low two bits are constant 1. No legal RV32I program can make imem_rd[0] transition 1->0; waived as a bounded proof, not a pass.

Provably unreachable: every RV32I instruction word has bits [1:0] == 2'b11 (the opcode field [6:0] is always odd with bit 1 set), so the fetched IMEM word's low two bits are constant 1. No legal RV32I program can make imem_rd[1] transition 1->0; waived as a bounded proof, not a pass.

Provably unreachable: the DMA engine performs word-aligned 32-bit copies. Both window base addresses (0x40/0x80/0xC0) and every row stride are word-indexed, so the per-word byte address is always 4-aligned; the master byte address's low two bits [1:0] are always 0 and no legal copy can make them transition. Waived as a bounded proof, not a pass.

Provably unreachable: fabric reads are combinational (bus_rdata = f(bus_addr), valid in the same cycle), so the AXI-like read-valid line bus_rvalid is driven constant 1 and can never transition 1->0. Waived as a bounded proof, not a pass.

coverage.note: Structural coverage is scoped to the SoC fabric (tiny_soc_core.sv) and the DMA engine (tiny_dma.sv): the interconnect decoder, control/status registers, operand/result SRAM, GEMM datapath, UART, instruction memory, a direct-mapped blocking instruction cache (4 lines x 4 words in the CPU fetch path, with the miss-stall assertion served to the wrapper), a direct-mapped non-blocking data cache (4 lines x 4 words in the CPU data path, bypassing to SRAM on a miss while the line refills, invalidated on host/DMA writes and on GEMM start), and the DMA engine with 2D scatter/gather, descriptor chains and interrupt (second bus master) that this stage-7 integration fixture actually contributes. The RV32I core (rv32_core.v) is reused IP that carries its own verification suite (benchmarks/rv32_single: 114 programs, 18099 retired instructions) and is compiled but not re-measured here; tiny_soc.sv is the wrapper that instantiates the CPU, does the debug/CPU bus mux, and gates the CPU clock on the cache stall. The fabric uses word-index interfaces (8-bit IMEM index, 9-byte address bus) so every fabric bit is toggle-coverable; the RV32I word-aligned PC's low address bits never reach the fabric. The bus is AXI-like: a write-ready line (bus_wready = !running) declares the operand-SRAM write port available, and a constant read-valid line (bus_rvalid) reflects that reads are combinational. coverage.unreachable declares the 19 structurally-unreachable toggle points: 2 RV32I opcode bits [1:0]=1 make imem_rd[1:0] constant 1; 16 DMA master address bits [1:0] are always 0 because every copy is word-aligned; and bus_rvalid is constant 1 because reads are combinational. They are waived with written justifications, recorded under waived_unreachable, and never counted as covered.

checks: synchronous reset clears done and idles the UART line high
the GEMM engine stays idle until CTRL start is pulsed
every C element read back through the bus equals the 32-bit wraparound GEMM with sign-bit ReLU
done asserts after the N^3-cycle GEMM and stays asserted while halted
UART transmits the written byte as a correct 8N1 frame (start, 8 data bits LSB-first, stop)
a second GEMM run with fresh operand matrices produces correct results
reset after a completed run clears the result register and done
the RV32I CPU drives the bus: fills A/B with 1s, starts the GEMM, polls STATUS, reads C[0]=4 into RESULT, sends UART 0x55, waits for the UART, and halts
a negative-sum GEMM clamps the ReLU result to 0 (sign-bit clamp path)
the DMA engine does a linear A->B copy with default strides and the destination words equal the diverse source data (second bus master)
the DMA engine copies across the remaining windows (C->A, B->C) and reports busy/done
the DMA engine does a 2D scatter/gather copy (source row stride 2 gathers, destination stride 4 is contiguous) and every destination word equals the gathered source word
the DMA interrupt (dma_irq pin and status[2]) asserts on done, clears on the next start, and re-asserts on the next done

the DMA engine walks a descriptor chain (descriptor 0 gathers A->B with source row stride 2; descriptor 1 copies B->C linearly and is marked last): B equals the gathered source words, C equals B, busy is observed during the chain, and the interrupt asserts once at the end of the whole chain

the bus is AXI-like handshaked: bus_wready is high while the GEMM is idle and drops while it runs, a raw write to A[0] driven during the run is dropped by the fabric (A[0] keeps its value), register writes (RESULT) are accepted regardless because they do not contend for the operand SRAM, and the host write task waits for ready before committing

the direct-mapped instruction cache refills a missing line from IMEM and serves hits combinationally: a cold probe (flush + probe) refills the line (the fabric asserts imem_stall and serves a NOP while refilling) and then returns the cached word, a hot probe of the same index is a clean hit with no refill, and the cache tags distinguish different 16-word blocks mapping to the same line

the data cache is direct-mapped and non-blocking: a cold probe of an A line misses (status valid=0) and bypasses to the SRAM word, an explicit fill makes the same line hit and return the cached word, every offset of the line hits, a host write clears the line so the next probe misses and bypasses to the new value, B and C tags distinguish windows mapping to the same line index, and starting the GEMM clears the whole cache
